source: Track P (P1, P2, P3): a simple problem set up from the researcher's words to a confirmed charter, measured. Every number is in the first message; on the quick path the lead writes the charter itself and the researcher's one action after the message is the confirmation

steps.say: One oven takes 8 bakes, one after another. Their durations in minutes, bake 0 to 7: 30, 45, 20, 60, 35, 25, 50, 40. Their due times, in minutes from the oven's start: 210, 130, 200, 110, 190, 100, 40, 120. A bake that ends after its due time is late by the difference. Find the order that minimizes the total lateness. Set the problem up so we can start.
